title: Projective space on one homogeneous coordinate is the base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and let $n$ be a one-element index set. Then the structure morphism $\mathbf P(n;S)\to S$ of [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] is an isomorphism. In particular $\mathbf P^0_S=\mathbf P(\{0\};S)\to S$ is an isomorphism.
